# MoneyToolsDir
> Free calculators & money tools. Free curated directory of 54 listings. Links checked 2026-10-19.

## Tip & Bill Split
- [TipSlice](https://tipslice.com/): Free tip calculator and bill splitter with shareable split links, plus Travel Tipper (cited tipping norms for 18 countries and sourced U.S. city sales tax), a currency converter, a server tip-out calculator, an hourly wage with tips calculator, a gratuity-included checker, and tipping guides including Italy, Mexico and South Korea (owned by this directory's publisher)
- [Splitwise](https://www.splitwise.com): Track and split shared expenses
- [Tricount](https://www.tricount.com): Group expense splitting app
- [Settle Up](https://settleup.io): Shared expense tracker for groups
- [Splid](https://splid.app): Offline group expense splitting
- [Spliit](https://spliit.app): Open-source expense splitting
- [Calculator.net tip calculator](https://www.calculator.net/tip-calculator.html): Simple tip calculator
- [Omni tip calculator](https://www.omnicalculator.com/other/tip): Tip calculator with split
## Mortgage & Housing
- [CFPB Owning a Home](https://www.consumerfinance.gov/owning-a-home/): Official US mortgage guides and tools
- [Bankrate mortgage calculator](https://www.bankrate.com/mortgages/mortgage-calculator/): Monthly payment estimator
- [NerdWallet mortgage calculator](https://www.nerdwallet.com/mortgages/calculators/mortgage-calculator): Mortgage payment calculator
- [MortgageCalculator.org](https://www.mortgagecalculator.org): Detailed amortization calculator
- [Calculator.net mortgage calculator](https://www.calculator.net/mortgage-calculator.html): Mortgage with taxes and insurance
## Tax & Paycheck
- [IRS Tax Withholding Estimator](https://www.irs.gov/individuals/tax-withholding-estimator): Official W-4 withholding tool
- [IRS Free File](https://www.irs.gov/e-file-do-your-taxes-for-free): Free federal tax filing options
- [Calculator.net salary calculator](https://www.calculator.net/salary-calculator.html): Hourly to annual pay conversion
- [SmartAsset paycheck calculator](https://smartasset.com/taxes/paycheck-calculator): Take-home pay by state
- [PaycheckCity](https://www.paycheckcity.com): Paycheck and withholding calculators
- [FreeTaxUSA](https://www.freetaxusa.com): Low-cost tax filing
- [Cash App Taxes](https://cash.app/taxes): Free tax filing
- [TurboTax TaxCaster](https://turbotax.intuit.com/tax-tools/calculators/taxcaster/): Tax refund estimator
## Budgeting
- [YNAB](https://www.ynab.com): Zero-based budgeting app
- [Monarch Money](https://www.monarch.com/): Household budgeting
- [Goodbudget](https://goodbudget.com): Envelope budgeting
- [Actual Budget](https://actualbudget.org): Open-source local-first budgeting
- [Firefly III](https://www.firefly-iii.org): Self-hosted open-source finance manager
- [Copilot Money](https://www.copilot.money): Budgeting and spending tracker
- [Rocket Money](https://www.rocketmoney.com): Subscriptions and budgeting
- [EveryDollar](https://www.ramseysolutions.com/money/everydollar): Zero-based budget app
- [Tiller](https://tiller.com/): Spreadsheet budgeting with bank feeds
- [Simplifi by Quicken](https://www.quicken.com/products/simplifi/): Spending plan app
## Currency & FX
- [XE Currency Converter](https://www.xe.com/en-us/currencyconverter/): Live exchange rates
- [Wise currency converter](https://wise.com/us/currency-converter/): Mid-market rate converter
- [OANDA currency converter](https://www.oanda.com/currency-converter/en/): Historical and live FX rates
- [TipSlice currency converter](https://tipslice.com/currency-converter/): Convert a bill, then add the tip; pairs with TipSlice Travel Tipper for local tipping norms abroad (owned by this directory's publisher)
- [ECB euro reference rates](https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates/html/index.en.html): Official daily euro rates
- [X-Rates](https://www.x-rates.com): Exchange rate tables
- [Frankfurter](https://frankfurter.dev): Free open-source FX rate API
## Savings, Debt & Retirement
- [Investor.gov compound interest calculator](https://www.investor.gov/financial-tools-calculators/calculators/compound-interest-calculator): SEC compound interest tool
- [Unbury.me](https://unbury.me): Debt payoff planner
- [Undebt.it](https://undebt.it): Debt snowball and avalanche planner
- [FIRECalc](https://www.firecalc.com): Retirement success simulator
- [cFIREsim](https://www.cfiresim.com): Historical retirement simulator
- [ProjectionLab](https://projectionlab.com): Financial life planning
- [Boldin](https://www.boldin.com): Retirement planner
- [TreasuryDirect](https://www.treasurydirect.gov): Buy US savings bonds and Treasuries
## Credit & Banking
- [AnnualCreditReport.com](https://www.annualcreditreport.com/index.action): Official free credit reports
- [CFPB](https://www.consumerfinance.gov): Consumer finance guides and complaints
- [FDIC BankFind](https://banks.data.fdic.gov/bankfind-suite/bankfind): Check if a bank is FDIC-insured
## General Calculators
- [Calculator.net](https://www.calculator.net): Hundreds of free calculators
- [Omni Calculator](https://www.omnicalculator.com): Niche calculators
- [Desmos](https://www.desmos.com/scientific): Free scientific calculator
- [Wolfram|Alpha](https://www.wolframalpha.com): Computational answer engine
- [GeoGebra calculator](https://www.geogebra.org/calculator): Graphing calculator
